title: Language, Legal, Notifications, Support
one_line: Four small popups that hang off Settings and share one builder and one chassis.

anatomy.spec: Small NX Card, radio list (bible 5.11): each language a row, selected row cream50 with a tick. English is the main language and stays live text throughout the app so others can be added without redrawing art.
TextPage chassis: nameplate (PRIVACY POLICY / TERMS OF SERVICE / SUPPORT), scrolling Nunito body text, close X.
Small NX Card, toggle rows per notification category (friend requests, rewards, events).

states: Text page loading (fetching latest legal copy) - skeleton lines, never blank
data: Language list and legal text: local strings today; consider a remote config fetch for legal text so it can update without a build.
do_not: Do not bake any of these labels into art - SETTINGS, LEGAL, ENGLISH, HAUSA, IGBO must all be live text (IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md section 4.3 explicitly drops the baked versions).
acceptance: All four sub-pages share the small-card chassis.
Legal text never shows blank while loading.
steps: 2. Confirm/rebuild the shared small-card chassis for all four sub-pages.
4. Add a loading state for legal text if it is remote.
prompt:
Polish the four Ludo NX settings sub-pages: Language, Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, Support, Notifications.

Read SCREEN_PLANS/specs/SHARED_RULES.md and this whole file. Use only values from UI_BIBLE/tokens.json.

All four share one small-NX-Card chassis and one builder. Language is a radio list with English as the live-text default (never baked - the old build had baked PNGs for ENGLISH, HAUSA, IGBO, TAROK; they must all be live text so more languages can be added later). Legal and Support are scrolling text pages with a nameplate and a close X. Notifications is a set of toggle rows by category.

Follow the 'steps' array. Finish with bible section 11 and the 'acceptance' list.
